title: germline-benchmark-smk
description:
A Snakemake 9 workflow that calls germline small variants from short reads with bcftools and FreeBayes, benchmarks the calls against the Genome in a Bottle HG002 v4.2.1 truth set with RTG vcfeval, stratifies the results by GA4GH/GIAB v3.3 stratification regions, and annotates the calls with ClinVar.

Each rule runs in its own conda environment. Execution profiles are provided for a local machine, a Slurm cluster and a small test run.
